parameters.query: select jsonb_object_agg(key, value) as cfg from app_config;

-- "Hash and lookup" node of workflow C1. Parameter: the uploaded file as base64.
-- sha256 is computed here in Postgres (Code nodes may not use the crypto module).
-- Returns ONE row: the hash, and the document if this exact file was already stored
-- (status extracted or needs_review). A document that earlier ended as 'failed' is NOT a duplicate:
-- sending it again retries it.
WITH h AS (SELECT encode(sha256(decode($1, 'base64')), 'hex') AS sha256)
SELECT h.sha256, d.id AS document_id, d.status, d.filename, c.contract_ref
FROM h
LEFT JOIN contract_documents d ON d.sha256 = h.sha256 AND d.status IN ('extracted', 'needs_review')
LEFT JOIN contracts c ON c.source_document_id = d.id
LIMIT 1;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ document_id: $json.document_id, status: 'duplicate', stored_status: $json.status, contract_ref: $json.contract_ref, warnings: [] }) }}

parameters.query:
-- "Load reference data" node of workflow C1. No parameters.
-- The tool names and the contracts already in the database. The validation uses them to
-- (1) accept only products we know and (2) refuse to overwrite an existing contract with different numbers.
SELECT
    (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(name), '[]'::jsonb) FROM tools) AS tools,
    (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
         'contract_ref', contract_ref, 'seats', seats, 'price_per_seat', price_per_seat,
         'start_date', to_char(start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'end_date', to_char(end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
         'notice_days', notice_days, 'auto_renew', auto_renew)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM contracts) AS contracts;

-- "Store document" node of workflow C1. Parameters in order: filename, sha256, status, extracted (JSON).
-- The hash is unique, so posting the same file again updates this row instead of adding another.
INSERT INTO contract_documents (filename, sha256, status, extracted)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (sha256) DO UPDATE SET
    filename    = EXCLUDED.filename,
    status      = EXCLUDED.status,
    extracted   = EXCLUDED.extracted,
    received_at = now()
RETURNING id AS document_id, status;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Read upload').first().json.filename, $('Hash and lookup').first().json.sha256, $('Validate extraction').first().json.status, JSON.stringify($('Validate extraction').first().json.extracted)] }}

parameters.query:
-- "Log failure" node of workflow C1. Parameters in order: failed (true/false), filename, document_id, error text.
-- Writes a dead_letter row only when the extraction itself failed (for example a wrong API key).
-- One open row per document, so retrying the same file does not pile up rows.
INSERT INTO dead_letter (workflow, node, payload, error)
SELECT 'C1 - Contract intake', 'LLM extraction',
       jsonb_build_object('document_id', $3::int, 'filename', $2::text), $4
WHERE $1::boolean
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dead_letter
                  WHERE workflow = 'C1 - Contract intake' AND node = 'LLM extraction' AND status = 'open'
                    AND (payload->>'document_id')::int = $3::int);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [String($('Validate extraction').first().json.llm_failed), $('Read upload').first().json.filename, String($('Store document').first().json.document_id), String($('Validate extraction').first().json.errors[0] ?? '')] }}

parameters.query:
-- "Upsert contract" node of workflow C1. Parameters in order: valid (true/false), document_id, extracted data (JSON).
-- Runs for every document but only writes when valid is true. The contract_ref is the key, so a re-run updates
-- the same contract. (The validation has already refused data that conflicts with an existing contract.)
INSERT INTO contracts (tool_id, contract_ref, seats, price_per_seat, billing_cycle, start_date, end_date,
                       notice_days, auto_renew, owner_email, source_document_id)
SELECT t.id, d.contract_ref, d.seats, d.price_per_seat, d.billing_cycle, d.start_date, d.end_date,
       d.notice_days, d.auto_renew, d.owner, $2::int
FROM jsonb_to_record($3::jsonb) AS d(
         product text, contract_ref text, seats int, price_per_seat numeric, billing_cycle text,
         start_date date, end_date date, notice_days int, auto_renew boolean, owner text)
JOIN tools t ON lower(t.name) = lower(d.product)
WHERE $1::boolean
ON CONFLICT (contract_ref) DO UPDATE SET
    tool_id            = EXCLUDED.tool_id,
    seats              = EXCLUDED.seats,
    price_per_seat     = EXCLUDED.price_per_seat,
    billing_cycle      = EXCLUDED.billing_cycle,
    start_date         = EXCLUDED.start_date,
    end_date           = EXCLUDED.end_date,
    notice_days        = EXCLUDED.notice_days,
    auto_renew         = EXCLUDED.auto_renew,
    owner_email        = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.owner_email, contracts.owner_email),
    source_document_id = EXCLUDED.source_document_id
RETURNING id AS contract_id, contract_ref, (xmax = 0) AS inserted;

-- "Save chunks" node of workflow C1. Parameters in order: document_id, chunks (JSON array of {chunk_index, content}).
-- The text is saved first, the embeddings follow in the next step. If embedding fails, the chunks stay with a
-- NULL embedding and can be embedded later (see embed_missing in docs). Chunks that no longer exist after a
-- re-ingest are removed.
WITH up AS (
    INSERT INTO contract_chunks (document_id, chunk_index, content, embedding)
    SELECT $1::int, (c->>'chunk_index')::int, c->>'content', NULL
    FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) AS c
    ON CONFLICT (document_id, chunk_index) DO UPDATE SET content = EXCLUDED.content, embedding = NULL
    RETURNING 1
),
gone AS (
    DELETE FROM contract_chunks
    WHERE document_id = $1::int
      AND chunk_index >= jsonb_array_length($2::jsonb)
    RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM up) AS saved, (SELECT count(*) FROM gone) AS removed;

-- "Save embeddings" node of workflow C1. Parameters in order: document_id, embeddings (JSON array of arrays,
-- in chunk order, as returned by Ollama /api/embed).
UPDATE contract_chunks c
SET embedding = (e.vec)::text::vector
FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS e(vec, n)
WHERE c.document_id = $1::int AND c.chunk_index = e.n - 1
RETURNING c.chunk_index;

-- "Log embedding failure" node of workflow C1. Parameters in order: document_id, filename, error text.
-- The contract data is already stored; only the search index is missing. The payload is enough to replay it:
-- embed the chunks of this document that still have a NULL embedding.
INSERT INTO dead_letter (workflow, node, payload, error)
SELECT 'C1 - Contract intake', 'Embed chunks',
       jsonb_build_object('document_id', $1::int, 'filename', $2::text), $3
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dead_letter
                  WHERE workflow = 'C1 - Contract intake' AND node = 'Embed chunks' AND status = 'open'
                    AND (payload->>'document_id')::int = $1::int);
